hero.title_html: The screen recorder that stays out of your video
hero.sub: ProRec captures your screen, a window, your webcam, system audio and microphone at up to 60 FPS in sharp H.264 — with a floating control panel you can see and your viewers can’t. Light on the CPU, works over Remote Desktop and on PCs without a GPU, and runs fully offline.
hero.alt: ProRec recording screen with mode selection, timer and the red record button

features.title: Everything you need to record. Nothing you don’t.
features.sub: Built for tutorials, gameplay, meetings and support videos.

items.title: Screen, area or window
items.text: Record one monitor, all monitors, a dragged area or a single app window. Reuse your last area in one click.

items.title: A control panel that is never recorded
items.text: A floating panel with timer, pause and screenshot is visible only to you. It is excluded from the capture itself (Windows 10 2004+), so your video stays clean.

items.title: Real cursor, clear clicks
items.text: The cursor keeps its true Windows shape. Add a highlight, click rings (left red, right blue) and a spotlight that dims everything else.

items.title: System audio + microphone
items.text: Capture what you hear and what you say, with separate volume sliders and device pickers.

items.title: Webcam, key presses, watermark
items.text: Add a round or rectangular webcam, show the keys you press for tutorials, and optionally stamp your own text.

items.title: Sharp H.264, small files
items.text: x264 encoding from small to near-lossless, accurate BT.709 colours, up to 60 FPS, saved as MP4 or MKV.

items.title: Light on your PC
items.text: GDI capture and CPU encoding: no GPU needed and it works over Remote Desktop. Choose a lighter speed for older machines.

items.title: Built-in tools
items.text: Trim, compress to 720p, make a GIF or extract the audio from any recording — right from the History tab.

items.title: Presets, schedule, auto-stop
items.text: Tutorial, Gaming, Low CPU and Max quality presets. Schedule a start time and set an automatic stop.

items.a: Yes. ProRec is freeware: free for personal, educational and commercial use, with no watermark, no ads and no time limit.

ProRec has no telemetry and its components are listed publicly. Because it is a new app without a paid code-signing certificate, Windows SmartScreen may show a warning. Verify the SHA-256 checksum on this page, then choose More info → Run anyway.

ProRec uses GDI capture, so some exclusive-fullscreen DirectX/OpenGL games may record as a black screen. Run the game in windowed or borderless mode, or record that window. Desktop apps, browsers, Office and Remote Desktop sessions work fine.

items.q: Does it work over Remote Desktop or without a GPU?
items.a: Yes. Capture uses GDI and encoding runs on the CPU. Do not minimise or disconnect the RDP window while recording, and enable Remote Audio if you want sound.

items.q: Why can’t I see the control panel in my video?
items.a: The floating panel is excluded from screen capture by Windows itself (Windows 10 version 2004 or later). On older versions ProRec turns the panel off and you can use hotkeys instead.

items.q: Does it need an internet connection?
items.a: No. The installer includes every language and the app works offline. The only network request is the optional “Check for updates” button.

items.q: How do I verify my download?
items.a: Open Command Prompt and run certutil -hashfile on the installer with SHA256, then compare the result with the checksum shown on this page.

items.q: How do I change the language?
items.a: You choose it at the start of the installer. Later, open Settings → Language: English, Bahasa Indonesia, Español, Français or 日本語.
In Videos\ProRec by default. You can change the folder in Settings → Storage.

items.q: Is there a version for Mac or Linux?
items.a: Not at the moment. ProRec is built for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit).
